{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').mean()

# Print the result
fraction_severe"}
